definition: Total office floorspace in the submarket, as reported by the market.
formula: Reported; areas converted from sq ft where the market reports in sq ft

definition: Floorspace available to let at the quarter end. Markets that report a vacancy rate instead of an area have it converted: stock x rate.
formula: Reported or stock_m2 x reported rate

definition: Share of stock that is vacant at the quarter end. At market level it is the stock-weighted rate: total vacant divided by total stock.
Floorspace let in the quarter (new leases, renewals counted only where the market counts them, expansions, subleases, pre-lets).
Take-up summed from the first quarter of the calendar year to this quarter.
formula: sum(take_up_m2) over the year to date

definition: Take-up summed over this quarter and the three before it. Null until four quarters exist.
Change in occupied space since the previous quarter. Occupied space is stock minus vacant space.

Headline rent achievable for the best space in the best location. Converted from the market's convention (GBP per sq ft per year, EUR per sq m per month) to EUR per sq m per year at the quarter's FX rate. At market level it is the highest submarket prime rent.
unit: EUR per sq m per year

metric_name: Prime rent growth year on year
definition: Change in the market prime rent against the same quarter a year earlier.
Net initial yield for a prime asset let to a strong tenant on a long lease. At market level the lowest submarket prime yield.
Office floorspace being built or comprehensively refurbished at the quarter end.
Bottom-up vacancy from the tracked building register: available space in tracked buildings divided by their total area. Used to reconcile the reported vacancy rate.
Number of leasing deals that passed every silver check in the quarter.
Area of logged deals as a share of reported take-up. Close to 1 means the deal log explains the headline.
